intro: Every month we score the country's most-streamed artists. The Pulse Score blends streaming, airplay and discovery across Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, Shazam and Deezer into a single monthly number.

highlights.artist: "Everybody Wanna Be In Love" - Calvin Fallo
highlights.note: One breakout hit delivered Calvin Fallo's entire monthly performance, making it August's strongest individual track.
Amapiano remained South Africa's dominant genre, led by Sam Deep and Calvin Fallo. Maskandi also continued its rise through Feza, MENZI MUSIC and Inkos'yamagcokama.
One of August's biggest movers, breaking into the upper tier through sustained Maskandi momentum.
The clear benchmark throughout the month, leading every reporting period.

editorial: August highlighted two powerful shifts in South African music.
Global catalogue continued to dominate, with Drake proving that long-term audience loyalty can outperform a single blockbuster release.

At the same time, local music gained even more ground. Amapiano remained a cultural powerhouse, while Maskandi strengthened its mainstream appeal through artists like Feza, MENZI MUSIC and Inkos'yamagcokama.
Calvin Fallo also showed the impact of a single cultural moment, with Everybody Wanna Be In Love emerging as August's defining track.
Together, the results reflect a music landscape where global staying power and local cultural momentum thrive side by side, offering valuable insight into both audience behaviour and emerging trends.
